capabilities: reads species notes from a user-configured folder (frontmatter identity plus one ## heading per care task)
shows an Almanac view grouping upcoming care windows into Open now, Coming up and Completed
tracks per-species task check-offs persisted in the plugin's data file rather than the notes
imports bundled species example templates into the species folder
refreshes automatically when species notes are created, edited, renamed or deleted
extras: README keeps developer template sections (clone, npm build, ESLint) under "How to use", and the API Documentation section is empty; check-off completion state is stored in the plugin's data file, not written back to the species notes.
intentEvidence: ports dotknewt/bonsai's "on the bench" care-window tracking into your vault
problem: Obsidian has no way to track seasonal, recurring care windows (repot, feed, prune, wire, pest) across species notes written as Markdown.

relations.evidence: Ported from the dotknewt/bonsai PWA, including its Markdown+frontmatter species format

summary: Bonsai care-window tracker that reads species notes (frontmatter plus one heading per task) and shows upcoming repotting, feeding, pruning and wiring windows in an Almanac view.
